preconditions: The FissionVM runtime is built from the Phase 3 checksum-qualified inputs.
The release AVM fixture is packaged in the exact OTP 26.0.2 and Elixir 1.17.3 environment.
Node 26.8.1, the runtime module, and the AVM bundle match their retained identities.
steps: Instantiate the release-node-probe WebAssembly runtime with fixed 256-page shared memory.
Boot the disposable release AVM fixture and execute process, mailbox, supervision, timer, generation, and cleanup probes.
Execute bounded protocol acceptance and rejection cases inside the Wasm runtime.
Capture and validate contiguous structured traces, final mailbox length, return value, and host memory pages.
expected_results: The supervised worker exchanges a message, crashes controllably, and restarts.
Selective receive, ordering, one-shot/repeated timers, timeout, stale generation, and late-result drainage behave as bounded by the contract.
Request identity, duplicate/stale/cancelled replies, failure classes, prohibited capabilities, and post-disposal traffic are handled explicitly.
A repeated process tree teardown leaves zero messages and the fixture returns ok with cleanup complete.
prohibited_results: A failed trace, nonzero runtime exit, missing sequence, growing final mailbox, memory growth, or unbounded wait.
Acceptance of code evaluation, a DOM handle, filesystem path, secret, arbitrary object, or unbounded binary.
A claim that the Node CLI proves browser loading or direct worker-separated host calls.
